description: Connects Saleem’s family story to national history, examining partition, unreliable memory, narrative form, and the politics of belonging. Covers Midnight’s Children: Kashmir, the Perforated Sheet, and the Two Infants; Midnight’s Children: Childhood, the Switch, and the Conference; Midnight’s Children: War, Memory, and Bangladesh; Midnight’s Children: Saleem, Padma, and Unreliable Memory.
